few_shot_examples.cq: What are all available publications and their titles?
What publications were submitted by authors who have a recorded role?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coress-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_shallow/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?title
WHERE {
  ?publication coress-ont:hasTitle ?title .
  ?publication coress-ont:submittedBy ?author .
  ?author rdfs:subClassOf coress-ont:Role .
  ?agent coress-ont:performsRole ?author .
}

few_shot_examples.cq: What publications were published after a certain date?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coress-ont: http://example.org/core_scholar_shallow/
PREFIX xsd: http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#
SELECT ?publication
WHERE {
 ?publication coress-ont ?date .
 FILTER (?date > "2020-01-01"^^xsd)
}

few_shot_examples.cq: What fields of study are represented by publications from universities in each state?
few_shot_examples.query:
PREFIX coress-ont: <http://example.org/core_scholar_shallow/>
SELECT ?state ?fieldOfStudy
WHERE {
  ?publication coress-ont:associatedFieldOfStudy ?fieldOfStudy .
  ?publication coress-ont:submittedBy ?author .
  ?agent coress-ont:performsRole ?author .
  ?agent coress-ont:worksInDepartment ?department .
  ?department coress-ont:departmentOf ?college .
  ?college coress-ont:collegeOf ?university .
  ?university coress-ont:atState ?state .
}
